description: This file defines a static class `DatabaseHealthCheckFlow` that performs a network-level health check of a PostgreSQL database by attempting a TCP connection to the database host and port. It includes related request and result record types, logs the flow, and encapsulates logic for extracting host/port from connection strings.

classes.name: DatabaseHealthCheckRequest
classes.description: Request object for initiating the database health check. Currently an empty record with potential for future options.

classes.name: DatabaseHealthCheckResult
classes.description: Result object containing the configuration and health status of the database, including an optional error message.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous TCP connectivity check to verify if the database host and port are reachable, returning a structured result.

methods.name: TryExtractHostPort
methods.description: Parses a connection string to extract the host and port information with a simple key-value parser.
